notes: RATH DataSource view. Distinctive: each column header is a mini field profile — field name in large light text, lightbulb 'Explore In Dataset' icon, a pale-blue 'transforms' chip with a green numeric dot, a Vega mini-chart (bars for categoricals, area for dates), and Unique/Count stats; hovering a header reveals semantic-type and analytic-type dropdowns (temporal/nominal, dimension/measure) and a 'use field' checkbox. A 3px colored top rule over each column marks enabled (blue #1a90ff) vs disabled (grey, e.g. order_id) fields. Rows containing problematic values are tinted salmon (#ffcbc7) with dark red text. Black primary split button ('Start Analysis' + mode dropdown) contrasts with a warm-grey secondary. Footer 'Powered by Kanaries Rath' centered at bottom. The table scrolls inside its own panel both horizontally (3520px) and vertically (2400 rows).
